hook.en: A company that makes only biscuits and one that makes biscuits, soaps and cement cannot have the same structure. Let us compare the two main shapes.
hook.kn: ಕೇವಲ ಬಿಸ್ಕತ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ಕಂಪನಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಸ್ಕತ್, ಸಾಬೂನು, ಸಿಮೆಂಟ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ರಚನೆ ಇರಲಾರದು. ಎರಡು ಮುಖ್ಯ ರಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸೋಣ.

objectives.en: State their merits, demerits and suitability

narration.en: A company that makes only biscuits and one that makes biscuits, soaps and cement cannot have the same structure. Let us compare the two main shapes.
narration.kn: ಕೇವಲ ಬಿಸ್ಕತ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ಕಂಪನಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಸ್ಕತ್, ಸಾಬೂನು, ಸಿಮೆಂಟ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ರಚನೆ ಇರಲಾರದು. ಎರಡು ಮುಖ್ಯ ರಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸೋಣ.

body.en: In a functional structure, jobs of a similar nature are grouped into functions such as production, purchase, marketing, finance and human resources, each under a head who reports to the managing director. It suits large firms with diversified activities needing high specialisation.

points.en: Merits: specialisation, control within a department, little duplication, easy training
Demerits: functional empires, poor inter-department coordination, conflict, inflexibility

narration.en: In a functional structure, jobs of a similar nature are grouped into functions such as production, purchase, marketing, finance and human resources, each under a head who reports to the managing director. It suits large firms with diversified activities needing high specialisation.
narration.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ರಚನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ, ಮಾರಾಟ, ಹಣಕಾಸು ಮುಂತಾದ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: On the board: functional vs divisional

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Functional structure: under the managing director, departments by function.
Divisional structure: under the MD, divisions by product.
Each division has its own functions inside it, like a small company.

narration.en: Sort each statement: functional structure or divisional structure.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಕಾರ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಅಥವಾ ವಿಭಾಗೀಯ ರಚನೆ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

prompt.en: Sort each statement: functional structure or divisional structure.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಕಾರ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಅಥವಾ ವಿಭಾಗೀಯ ರಚನೆ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

explanation.en: A functional structure groups by function and gains specialisation; a divisional structure groups by product and gains accountability, at the cost of duplication.

text.en: Departments: production, purchase, marketing, finance, HR
Similar jobs grouped together for specialisation
Economies of scale from grouping similar work
Coordination between departments gets harder as the firm grows
Divisions for soaps, foods and personal care, each with its own marketing
Develops all-round managers who run a whole division
Easy to fix accountability for each product
Division heads may compete for funds

body.en: In a divisional structure, the organisation is grouped into divisions on the basis of products or product lines; each division has its own production, marketing and finance. It suits firms with many different products. It develops all-round managers and makes accountability easy, but duplicates resources and may cause conflict between divisions.

points.en: Merits: product specialisation, easy accountability, flexibility, easy expansion
Demerits: duplication, higher cost, conflict over resources

narration.en: In a divisional structure, the organisation is grouped into divisions on the basis of products or product lines; each division has its own production, marketing and finance. It suits firms with many different products. It develops all-round managers and makes accountability easy, but duplicates resources and may cause conflict between divisions.
narration.kn: ವಿಭಾಗೀಯ ರಚನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ; ಪ್ರತಿ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ತನ್ನದೇ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು. ಅನೇಕ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳಿರುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ.

body.en: One product with many specialised tasks: functional. Many different products: divisional. Think "F for Few products, D for Diverse products".

narration.en: One product with many specialised tasks: functional. Many different products: divisional. Think "F for Few products, D for Diverse products".

mnemonic.en: F = Few products → Functional; D = Diverse products → Divisional

problem.en: A Hubballi company makes only steel pipes and has 2,000 employees doing purchase, production, sales and accounts. Another makes pipes, paints and packaged water. Suggest a structure for each, with reasons.

steps.en: First company: one product line but large, specialised work: functional structure.
Second company: three unrelated products with different customers: divisional structure.
Divisional helps fix the profit responsibility of each product head.

answer.en: Functional for the pipe maker; divisional for the multi-product company.

points.en: Functional structure groups jobs by function.
Divisional structure groups by product; each division has its own functions.
Divisional: easy accountability but duplication of costs.

narration.en: Recap. Functional structure groups jobs by function. Divisional structure groups by product; each division has its own functions. Functional: specialisation but coordination problems. Divisional: easy accountability but duplication of costs.
